span.p:
alternatives benchmarked on the same audio (D30)
- faster-whisper / CTranslate2 int8_float16
(probably REQUIRED to hit latency on a 3050)
- Typhoon ASR
- cloud STT as the fallback adapter

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the 3050 constraint. 4-6GB. Whisper pads every
chunk to 30s regardless of real length, which is why
segmentation matters so much. Do NOT plan to run a
local LLM and Whisper on the same card - the default
split is STT local, LLM via API.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why re-implement rather than copy the old project?
The reference code is FILE-BASED: record, then transcribe.
This system needs streaming - partial results while the
customer is still talking. Different shape entirely,
so it is reference for model behaviour, not code to copy. (D9)
